title: The signed shift of the projection-normalized Roos model
statement: Let A be an abelian category with countable products. There is a comparison Roos(C[r])≅Roos(C)[r] for every strict countable tower C of unbounded cochain complexes and every integer r. Its first coordinate is the inverse projection-defined shift/product comparison; its second coordinate is the same comparison multiplied by (-1)^r. Thus it satisfies both defining laws of PodSignedRoosShift. [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]

proof.text:
regard the strict tower as a complex in the category of towers. Apply the
native Roos commutation with shifts. Its product comparison is the inverse of
the projection-defined shift/product comparison, since their composites with
each product projection agree. The first coordinate formula is roosShift_v;
the second is roosShift_u and retains exactly the sign (-1)^r. Converting the
tower presentation changes none of its objects, differentials or transitions.
The proof applies to every integer shift and every unbounded strict tower.
